leads.title: Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms - Section 15(1)
leads.documents: Constitutional equality guarantee interpreted to protect LGBTQ people from discrimination; text of s.15(1) and application to laws, government and law enforcement
leads.detail: Quoted in article: '15(1) Every individual is equal before and under the law...' - Charter in Constitution 1982, in force 1985; no URL in excerpt

leads.title: Egan v. Canada, 1995 - Supreme Court of Canada
leads.documents: Landmark ruling that sexual orientation is included in s.15 as an analogous ground, granting equal protection
leads.detail: Cited as 1995 landmark decision; reaffirmed 2008 equality language; no URL in excerpt

leads.title: Vriend v Alberta, 1998 - Supreme Court of Canada
leads.documents: Failure of provincial legislature to include sexual orientation in human rights law is itself a s.15 Charter violation; basis for all provinces/territories + federal inclusion by 2017
leads.detail: 1998 decision; supports Ontario human-rights protections for sexual orientation and gender identity; no URL in excerpt

leads.title: Ontario Court of Appeal - Same-Sex Marriage Decision (2003 Halpern line)
leads.documents: Struck down federal common-law opposite-sex definition of marriage; held new inclusive definition effective immediately in Ontario, leading other provinces
leads.detail: Article notes: 'the Ontario Court of Appeal in its decision held that the new definition came into effect immediately in Ontario'; same-sex marriage legal in Ontario in 2003; no URL in excerpt

leads.title: Civil Marriage Act - Federal Parliament, July 20, 2005
leads.documents: Nationwide legalization of same-sex marriage; Canada 4th country worldwide, 1st in Americas, no residency requirement
leads.detail: Passed after Supreme Court Reference Dec 2004 found proposed definition consistent with Charter and within federal authority; no URL in excerpt

leads.title: Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1968-69 (Bill C-150)
leads.documents: Decriminalized same-sex sexual activity in private between consenting adults, in force on royal assent June 27, 1969
leads.detail: Introduced 1967 by Justice Minister Pierre Trudeau - 'There's no place for the state in the bedrooms of the nation'; no URL in excerpt

leads.title: Criminal Code s.159 - Unconstitutionality Findings and Repeal via Bill C-75
leads.documents: Former anal-intercourse offence with unequal age limit; Ontario, Quebec, BC, Nova Scotia, Alberta courts each declared s.159 unconstitutional under Charter s.15; repealed with royal assent June 21, 2019
leads.detail: Bill C-32 incorporated into C-75 tabled March 2018; age of consent harmonized to 16 (18 with trust/authority/dependency); statement by MP Randy Boissonnault cited; no URL in excerpt

leads.title: Criminal Code - Statutory Ban on Conversion Therapy (2022)
leads.documents: Nationwide statutory ban on subjecting anyone, minors and adults, to conversion therapy as defined in Criminal Code; criminal offence
leads.detail: Article states Canada in 2022 was 3rd country worldwide, 1st in North America to ban by statute; no URL in excerpt

leads.title: Expungement of Historically Unjust Convictions Act - Royal Assent June 21, 2018
leads.documents: Allows destruction/removal of RCMP/federal records for pre-1969 homosexual acts and s.159 convictions; notifies provincial/municipal police and courts; available to living and deceased
leads.detail: Follows PM Justin Trudeau formal apology Nov 28, 2017 in Parliament; Parole Board distinction expungement vs pardon/record suspension explained; no URL in excerpt

leads.title: Canadian Association of Chiefs of Police - Formal Apology and Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Committee, December 2020
leads.documents: Institutional enforcement acknowledgement: past laws/policies contributed to bias, intolerance, human-rights violations against Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer communities; commitment to stand against homophobia/transphobia
leads.detail: Issued on International Day of Human Rights 2020; created CACP Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Committee to mitigate implicit bias and systemic barriers; long direct quote in article; no URL in excerpt
